sources.description: Master prompt: Archestimator Cloudflare Hosted-Release, Recovery, and Operations Audit Plan Pack (Philip, 2026-07-19). Establishes the 12 audit domains (O-01..O-12), evidence-layer model, authorization boundary (read-only hosted verification), and required artifacts.

requirements.statement: Hosted D1 recovery posture (backup cadence, restore window, restore duration, permissions) must be proven before controlled-beta admit.
Hosted alert delivery for S-01..S-07 scenarios must be verified before controlled-beta admit.
Hosted Google OAuth round-trip must be exercised end-to-end before controlled-beta admit.
Email DNS topology + SPF/DMARC/DKIM deliverability posture must be aligned before relying on magic-link or sending cohort notifications.
Hosted queue/DLQ/DO/R2 operational baselines must be captured with documented inspection cadence and replay contract.
Controlled-beta release-gate ritual must be established and executed before each cohort wave with a recorded release receipt.
Hosted deployment provenance (version + source SHA + latest-deploy smoke) must be captured at each cohort admit.
Hosted D1 migration parity + schema fingerprint + retention cadence must be verified.

assumptions.statement: AUTH-001 (wrangler auth expired) is resolvable by the operator in an interactive terminal. Until resolved, hosted-evidence claims for deployment SHA, D1 info/backups, R2 listing, queue depth, DO storage, secret names, and Workers Logs retention remain EVIDENCE_BLOCKED.

.ai/03_plans/2026-07-31/Code-Improvement/ is the current owner of CI truthful-claims and CI activation; historical predecessor pointers are Quality Master UNIT-002 and Infosec UNIT-012. This pack's release-gate ritual substitutes for CI enforcement during controlled beta and does not duplicate that work.
Email DNS topology decision (Option A vs Option B in UNIT-004) is operator-gated; Option B is the minimum bar for controlled beta.

risks.statement: AUTH-001 blocks all wrangler auth-gated readback; without operator session, the three NO_GO blockers cannot be resolved.
Email topology decision (UNIT-004 Option A vs B) affects outbound deliverability; wrong choice could softfail cohort notifications.
DO state corruption has no operator-quarantine runbook today; risk is bounded for controlled beta but escalates for public beta.
workers.dev secondary origin reachable; partial mitigation via canonical-host redirect; full remediation belongs to .ai/03_plans/2026-07-31/Code-Improvement/ (historical Infosec UNIT-002).
CI disabled; for controlled beta, release-gate ritual substitutes; not a blocker.

units.goal: Establish hosted D1 recovery posture: preview-only restore drill, production restore command chain, RPO/RTO targets.
Verify hosted observability + alert delivery for S-01..S-07 scenarios.
Exercise hosted Google OAuth round-trip with a real test account.
Align email DNS topology + SPF/DMARC/DKIM deliverability posture.
Establish hosted queue/DLQ/DO/R2 operational baselines + documented inspection cadence.
Establish controlled-beta release-gate ritual + deployment provenance capture.
Verify hosted D1 migration parity + schema fingerprint + retention cadence.

decisions.statement: Lane = Plan Pack (explicit master prompt + genuinely high-blast-radius surface: hosted release, recovery, operations).
Profile = high-blast-radius; ceiling = IMPLEMENT_LOCAL; last observed scope = READ_ONLY. Operator-driven hosted verification only.
One writer (lead); no parallel writes; subagents used only for read-only investigation.
Hosted probe scope = DNS + HTTPS GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only; no Cloudflare API write; no real email; no D1/R2/queue mutation.
RPO/RTO targets: operator decision pending at UNIT-001 execution; record in d1-backup-restore-readiness.md.
Email DNS topology operator decision (Option A migrate to Cloudflare Email Routing vs Option B documented operational split) deferred to UNIT-004; Option B is the minimum bar for controlled beta.
Controlled-beta decision = CONDITIONAL_GO; three NO_GO blockers (GATE-RECOVERY-001, GATE-ALERT-002, GATE-OAUTH-003); five CONDITIONAL items accepted with documented mitigations.

Evidence-honesty repair at improvement pass: AC-004/005/006 demoted from PASS to BOUNDARY and EVID-004/005/006 from PASS to STALE, because each evidence record's own narrative says the work is not done (email topology not aligned, queue/DO/R2 baselines EVIDENCE_BLOCKED, release-gate ritual not executed). AUTH-002 added to bound the two operator-action criteria (AC-004 DNS change, AC-006 cohort admit) that are not wrangler-token-gated.

authorization_boundaries.statement: Cloudflare hosted reads via wrangler are blocked by an expired token in this non-interactive session. Continuation: interactive terminal -> bunx wrangler login (or set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN) -> re-run the readback commands listed per finding. Bounds: deployment SHA, D1 info/backups/migrations list/schema, R2 object listing, queue depth, DO storage, secret names (never values), Workers Logs retention. Never authorized in this audit: deploy, secret sync/value read, DNS change, production D1 writes/exports/time-travel restore, production R2 mutation, queue replay/purge, DLQ mutation, cron change, DO production-state mutation, real outbound email, GitHub settings change, paid add-on, account change.

Operator-gated production actions that no audit session (interactive or not) may take autonomously: DNS-record changes for email topology alignment (UNIT-004 Option A/B) and the cohort-admit release-gate ritual that mutates the operator ledger and admits design partners (UNIT-006). These are deliberately operator decisions, not wrangler-token-gated reads. Continuation: operator (Philip) executes the DNS change or cohort admit per the unit's implementation boundary, records the result in the named evidence artifact, and updates release-gate.json. Never authorized in this audit: the audit itself performing DNS changes, sending cohort notifications, or recording an admit decision.

ready_slices.statement: Operator readiness wave (entry): UNIT-001 (D1 recovery posture). UNIT-002..005 and UNIT-007 are also dependency-free and can run in parallel once AUTH-001 is resolved. UNIT-006 (release-gate ritual) is gated on UNIT-001/002/003 NO_GO resolution and is intentionally NOT in a ready slice until those units are VERIFIED.
